author: Krusher97 (issue reporter), comment of 2017-09-27: 'Contains a savestate and an ingame state.'
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue)
what_it_is: The reporter's own Mischief Makers game: file 1 'aaa', 01 hrs 18 min 36 sec, 291 gems, reaching level 2-3. A 4 Kbit EEPROM written as a 2048-byte .eep: the game's 512 bytes (data to 0x1DF), then 1536 bytes of 0xFF. Zip entry dated 2017-09-27 01:54.
note: The reporter says they ran the m64p build from m64p.github.io (mupen64plus-gui on mupen64plus-core); the maintainer replies with mupen64plus-gui instructions. '<GoodName>.eep' is mupen64plus-core's naming of that time, and 2048 bytes for a 4 Kbit game is how mupen64plus-core wrote every EEPROM before 2017-2018 (one-saves' n64.rs mentions it). The zip's other file, mischief.state, a save state, was not kept. Which revision: the 2017 GoodName 'Mischief Makers (U) [!]' carries no version, so (USA) rather than (USA) (Rev 1) is a guess. Copied unchanged into the EEPROM region of a Mupen64Plus-Next .srm and booted with Mischief Makers (USA) (Rev 1), the game shows the file: proof.png is that check, not the author's screenshot.
